incorrect_phrase: No symmetry quotient for block-state enumeration
actual_enumeration: All278 labelled core truth tables are retained. The7070 block states are representatives indexed by remaining block lengths and revealed-sign products; within-block remaining-coordinate identities are canonically renamed. This exact symmetry is justified because parity is invariant under permutations inside its block; both legal physical coordinates of every unqueried two-bit representative and both outcomes are explicitly checked. It is not an exhaustive list of separately named partial physical histories.
justification: Each block parity and its product of already revealed signs are invariant under within-block coordinate renaming; coefficientwise injective union map in DERIVATION proves the reduction. Checker tests both possible first physical coordinates and both signs.
